name: Magic academy
gm_moves: turn an ordinary exam or lecture into a personal rivalry
ring the curfew bell right when they are deepest off-limits
let a faculty member offer help with invisible strings attached
make house standings shift because of one student's mistake
wake up something old that the founders bricked behind the classroom wall
checks: a ladder of 3+ steps that rise one after another
no empty story axis, and no seed fact contradicted
school rules and academic stakes matter alongside danger
